## Which grab this is — read before trusting the word "baseline"

**This is grab 2 of the three-grab cadence (the error check), not grab 1.** The
publish had already happened when it ran, so there is no pre-publish snapshot
taken in the moment. What makes it usable as a baseline anyway is that the grab
window reaches back to 07-24, so **the pre-update reference is the settled
history inside this same grab** — 2026-08-20 and the 7-day mean. That is
legitimate, but it is a weaker instrument than a real grab 1, and the difference
should be stated whenever this is quoted.

**Today (08-21) is partial and must not be used as a "before" for anything.**

## Dating the publish — probable, not confirmed

| Evidence | Says |
|---|---|
| Dimension discovery returned `PlaceVersion` **1705** | A version above anything previously seen |
| `feedback.csv` max `asset_version` = **1698**, last row 2026-08-20T23:44Z | v1698 was still live late on 08-20 |
| `ErrorCount` `LogSource: Server`, 08-21 = **3,029,260 (partial)** against a 96K–182K/day week | A deploy happened today |

**Conclusion: an update shipped on 2026-08-21, most probably v1705.**

**The publish time is NOT known, and three instruments failed to give it:**
`place-versions` 500'd on both requests (F12 again on this universe, so
`place-versions.csv` is stale and tops out at sub-place versions); `feedback.csv`
has no 08-21 rows at all; and the `ErrorCount` **half-hour series stops at
2026-08-21T00:00:00Z**, so today's intraday shape is not in this grab. Do not
quote a publish hour off this baseline.

## Bottom line

- **Nothing is broken that this grab can see.** The one large signal — server
  errors at ~17× — is the documented publish signature on this exact universe,
  not a defect. It is only a finding if it is still elevated tomorrow.
- **The game is in a hard growth spike**, roughly doubling week over week, and
  the update landed on top of that. Every volume metric will look spectacular
  tomorrow for reasons that have nothing to do with the update. Use rates.
- **Almost nothing else is answerable yet.** DAU, revenue, session length and
  the downvote rate on the new version all first read on **2026-08-22**; D1 on
  **2026-08-23**.

**Shape read.** Conversion breadth is exceptional (4.12%, top decile) while depth
is weak (ARPPU R$16.03, below median) — many payers buying small, the mirror
image of Banana Monkey. Retention is the soft rung at every horizon (D1 13.4%,
D7 0.95%, D30 0.18%), and that is what caps how long this spike lasts.
Performance is healthy and is not currently a constraint.

**Downvote rate by version — the instrument that moves first:**

| Version | Up | Down | Downvote rate | Live from |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1683 | 18 | 4 | 18.2% | 2026-07-28 |
| 1685 | 29 | 5 | **14.7%** | 2026-07-31 |
| 1691 | 8 | 7 | 46.7% | 2026-08-08 |
| **1698** | 22 | 17 | **43.6%** | 2026-08-14 |

Roughly a tripling from v1685 to v1691/v1698. **Confounded** — DAU also roughly
tripled over the same span, and a broader audience votes differently. Treat as a
WATCH, not a finding. n is about 35 per version.

## What could not be measured, and why

An absent measurement is not a clean bill of health.

- **Publish time to the minute** — three instruments failed, see above.
- **Today's intraday errors and CCU** — the half-hour series clamps at
  2026-08-21T00:00:00Z in this grab. A grab 2 taken for intraday error shape
  needs the sub-daily window to actually reach today; here it did not.
- **Error message text** — the `MessageHash` dimension lookup **500'd** on this
  universe, as it has before. So we hold error *volumes* with no text. Text
  requires the Studio export.
- **Funnel step and CustomField1 dimensions** — 403.
- **`DailyCohortRetention` by CohortDay** — 400. That shape needs a window of 10
  days or less; see CLAUDE.md.
- **`ForwardD1Retention` by PlaceVersion** — 400 on an inferred shape, so it is
  reported as n/a and is never a finding about the game.
